facts.text: Bajaj Finance, the financing group's lending arm, lists two-wheeler loans from ₹35,000 to ₹21 lakh and conditional funding up to 100% of the on-road price. Purchase completion uses a selected partner dealership and credit assessment. This is finance, not motorcycle manufacturing.
